title: Append-only evidence-event log with inclusion, consistency, and equivocation witnesses
hypothesis: A deterministic local transparency contract can reject deleted, reordered, mutated, or forked evidence events and can distinguish inclusion in an append-only structure from the truth, authority, or external publication of the logged claim.
falsifier: Mutate event bytes, order, tree size, leaf index, proof path, prior root, canonical encoding, duplicate identity, and claim role; require every inconsistent extension or false-independence case to fail closed while truth and external-publication claims remain false.
boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, sentience, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, production-readiness, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-team-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
